PublicRemarks: Great opportunity in Charlotte's growing Oakdale area! Whether you're looking for a place to call home or an investor seeking to add to your portfolio, 2412 Smugglers Court offers plenty of potential. The property has been consistently tenant-occupied since the current owner purchased it in 2008 and has never been owner-occupied, demonstrating its long-standing appeal as a rental while offering a new owner the opportunity to make it their own. Major updates include the HVAC system, water heater, and dishwasher, all replaced in 2019. The surrounding Oakdale area continues to see reinvestment, with newer construction and renovated homes nearby contributing to the neighborhood's evolving character and appeal. Conveniently located with access to shopping, dining, employment centers, and major thoroughfares, this property is well positioned to enjoy all that Charlotte's continued growth has to offer. Don't miss your opportunity to own in an established and evolving Charlotte neighborhood!

LAKE NORMAN LIVING WITH COMMUNITY LAKE ACCESS! Welcome to 149 Lakeshore Drive, a distinctive home in the highly sought-after Lakeview Shores community. Enjoy the best of the Lake Norman lifestyle with community access that includes a boat ramp, paddlesport launch, pier/day dock, and convenient access to the water for boating, kayaking, paddleboarding, fishing, and relaxing lakeside days. This beautiful home offers versatile living space on a spacious 0.48-acre lot. The unique floor plan is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, with a primary suite on the main level, distinctive architectural details, and flexible gathering spaces. Outdoor living shines with an inviting backyard and space to gather with family and friends. Location is a major highlight. Situated near the popular LangTree area and I-77's LangTree Road interchange, you're minutes from an array of shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and everyday conveniences. LangTree Lake Norman offers an extensive mix of retail and dining, while nearby River Highway provides even more shopping and restaurant options. Whether you're looking for a full-time residence, a Lake Norman getaway, or a home designed for entertaining, 149 Lakeshore Drive delivers a unique combination of character, flexibility, outdoor living, and easy access to everything Mooresville and Lake Norman have to offer.
